title: ACDP Registry Capabilities (v0.1.0)
description: The capability declaration document served at /.well-known/acdp.json. Tells consumers what algorithms, profiles, and limits the registry supports.

acdp_version.description: The ACDP specification version this registry implements.

registry_did.description: The registry's own DID, typically did:web:<hostname>.

supported_signature_algorithms.description: Signature algorithms accepted on publish. MUST contain 'ed25519' (RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.10). Open vocabulary; see registries/signature-algorithms.md.

read_authentication_methods.description: Read-authentication methods supported by this registry. Open vocabulary; current registered values are 'http_signatures', 'mtls', 'oauth' (see registries/auth-methods.md). At least one MUST be declared if the registry serves any non-public contexts. See RFC-ACDP-0008 §6.2.

anonymous_public_reads.description: Whether anonymous (unauthenticated) reads are permitted for public contexts. See RFC-ACDP-0008 §6.3.

supported_did_methods.description: DID methods this registry can resolve. MUST contain 'did:web' (RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.4, §5.11). Examples: 'did:web', 'did:key'.

supports_idempotency_key.description: Whether this registry honors the Idempotency-Key header on POST /contexts. See RFC-ACDP-0003 §6.

profiles.description: Profile(s) this implementation claims conformance to. MUST contain 'acdp-registry-core' for any registry. Current registered profiles are 'acdp-registry-core', 'acdp-registry-discovery', 'acdp-registry-federated', 'acdp-consumer' (see RFC-ACDP-0001 §9.1). Open vocabulary so future profiles (e.g. 'acdp-registry-receipts') can be added without a schema bump.

keyless.description: (0.5.0, Draft) Keyless-signing configuration (RFC-ACDP-0021 §13). MUST be present when profiles contains 'acdp-registry-keyless', and absent otherwise.

accepted_oidc_issuers.description: OIDC issuer URIs whose tokens this registry verifies, compared byte for byte with the token's iss.

accepted_spiffe_trust_domains.description: SPIFFE trust domains whose JWT-SVIDs this registry verifies.

max_attestation_ttl_seconds.description: Longest attestation window this registry mints.

max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum size of a publish request body in bytes.

max_embedded_bytes.description: Maximum decoded size of any embedded data reference. Fixed at 64 KB by the spec.

idempotency_key_ttl_seconds.description: How long this registry retains (agent_id, Idempotency-Key) → response mappings. MUST be advertised when supports_idempotency_key is true. Range: 24h to 7d (RFC-ACDP-0003 §6.2).

max_publish_per_minute.description: OPTIONAL (0.3.0, RFC-ACDP-0007 §3.2, RFC-ACDP-0008 §4.3): the nominal per-agent publish ceiling this registry enforces on POST /contexts, in requests per minute. Advisory for producer pacing; its presence does NOT relax the RFC-ACDP-0008 §4.3 requirements (per-agent rate limiting is REQUIRED regardless, and 429 responses MUST carry Retry-After). The one 0.3.0 addition to this closed sub-object — strict pre-0.3.0 validators of `limits` will reject documents carrying it.

change_retention_seconds.description: (0.5.0, Draft) How long this registry retains GET /changes entries and honours feed cursors pointing at them. MUST be advertised with acdp-registry-changes; at least 30 days (RFC-ACDP-0018 §5.4, §9).

max_change_filters.description: (0.5.0, Draft) Maximum total ctx_id/lineage_id/agent_id/kind values accepted in one GET /changes request or subscription filter. MUST be advertised with acdp-registry-changes (RFC-ACDP-0018 §5.1, §9).

max_changes_page.description: (0.5.0, Draft) Largest GET /changes limit this registry accepts. MUST be advertised with acdp-registry-changes (RFC-ACDP-0018 §5.1, §9).

max_subscriptions_per_requester.description: (0.5.0, Draft) Maximum change-hint subscriptions one requester DID may hold. MUST be advertised with acdp-registry-events (RFC-ACDP-0018 §8.1, §9).

limits.$comment: Closed sub-object (RFC-ACDP-0007 §3.3.1, fixture schema-010). v0.1.0 defines max_payload_bytes, max_embedded_bytes, idempotency_key_ttl_seconds; 0.3.0 adds the optional max_publish_per_minute; 0.5.0 (Draft) adds the optional RFC-ACDP-0018 change-feed and subscription limits.

$comment: additionalProperties is true to support forward compatibility — future versions will add capability flags here.
